lrw.text: Nath, the Gilt-Leaf commander, orders an attack on the Feast of Footbottom despite Rhys's report that it is a peaceful festival, and the boggarts turn feral under the coming Great Aurora.

Overwhelmed, Rhys invokes Colfenor's magic and causes a poison blast that kills everyone except himself, Gryffid and Nath, after which Nath offers Gryffid a choice and Gryffid swears allegiance and becomes his second-in-command.
Nath arrives to besiege Kinsbaile, where Gaddock Teeg welcomes him and the clachan falls immediately, and he and Gryffid wait for Rhys to return.
Rhys comes back, fights his former tribesmen and kills Nath, driving the elves out of the clachan.

shm.text: In Shadowmoor, Nath punishes Daen Rhys for a failed boggart raid, kills Yelm, demotes Rhys and gives the Hemlock pack to Gryffid.
After the poison blast leaves only Rhys, Gryffid and Nath alive and Nath's glamer failed, Gryffid sees Nath's true form and chooses to keep his secret, and Nath heals and promotes him.

Nath challenges Rhys to a duel at Kinsbaile, and Rhys, wounded by the cuffhounds, kills him in hand-to-hand combat, his glamer failing at death, while Gryffid finds the body, sets up a funeral pyre and swears to kill Rhys.
